name: What is the difference between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vinyl windows are a popular, cost-effective option known for low maintenance and good insulation. Wood windows offer a classic aesthetic and excellent insulation but require more maintenance to prevent rot or warping. Fiberglass windows are highly durable, stable, and energy-efficient, resisting expansion and contraction, making them a premium choice that can mimic the look of wood without the high maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vinyl windows are affordable and low-maintenance; wood offers classic aesthetics but requires upkeep; fiberglass is durable, stable, and energy-efficient.
